evidence.reference_title: Disruption of a ciliary B9 protein complex causes Meckel syndrome.
evidence.snippet: Mice lacking B9d1 displayed polydactyly, kidney cysts, ductal plate malformations, and abnormal patterning of the neural tube, concomitant with compromised ciliogenesis, ciliary protein localization, and Hedgehog (Hh) signal transduction.

evidence.reference_title: Compound heterozygous missense and intronic variants in B9D1 contribute to a recurrent Meckel syndrome pedigree.
evidence.snippet: Compound heterozygous missense and intronic variants in B9D1 contribute to a recurrent Meckel syndrome pedigree.

evidence.reference_title: Disruption of a ciliary B9 protein complex causes Meckel syndrome.
evidence.snippet: We identified a homozygous c.301A>C (p.Ser101Arg) B9D2 mutation that segregates with MKS

nodes.description: Basal bodies localize apically, yet cilia fail to form in many tissues.
nodes.id: Basal body localization without proper ciliogenesis

evidence.reference_title: A mouse model for Meckel syndrome reveals Mks1 is required for ciliogenesis and Hedgehog signaling.
evidence.snippet: loss of Mks1 in vivo does not interfere with apical localization of epithelial basal bodies but rather leads to defective cilia formation in most, but not all, tissues.

evidence.reference_title: Identification of CC2D2A as a Meckel syndrome gene adds an important piece to the ciliopathy puzzle.
evidence.snippet: we identified the sixth locus and the fifth gene, CC2D2A (MKS6), behind MKS.

evidence.reference_title: Diagnostic use of computational retrotransposon detection: Successful definition of pathogenetic mechanism in a ciliopathy phenotype.
evidence.snippet: A medical exome analysis detected a heterozygous frameshift mutation, c.4582_4583delCG p.(Arg1528Serfs*17) in CC2D2A in the maternally derived allele.

evidence.reference_title: Three Novel Variants of CEP290 and CC2D2DA and a Link Between ZNF77 and SHH Signaling Pathway Are Found in Two Meckel-Gruber Syndrome Fetuses.
evidence.snippet: Whole exome sequencing identified a compound heterozygous of two novel variants of CEP290 and a heterozygous of a novel variant of CC2D2A.

evidence.reference_title: Mutations of the CEP290 gene encoding a centrosomal protein cause Meckel-Gruber syndrome.

evidence.reference_title: Evaluation of novel compound variants of CEP290 in prenatally suspected case of Meckel syndrome through whole exome sequencing.
evidence.snippet: compound heterozygous mutations of CEP290 c.3175dup and CEP290 c.1201dup were detected through WES.

evidence.snippet: the underlying mutated gene, TMEM67, encodes transmembrane protein 67, also called meckelin (OMIM 609884), which is an integral protein of the renal epithelial cell and membrane of the primary cilium.

evidence.reference_title: The ciliary gene RPGRIP1L is mutated in cerebello-oculo-renal syndrome (Joubert syndrome type B) and Meckel syndrome.

nodes.description: Disruption of the B9-TMEM67 complex at the transition zone reduces axonemal microtubule modifications.

evidence.reference_title: Ciliopathy-related B9 protein complex regulates ciliary axonemal microtubule posttranslational modifications and initiation of ciliogenesis.
evidence.snippet: the B9 complex interacted with and anchored TMEM67 to the TZ membrane.

evidence.reference_title: Ciliopathy-related B9 protein complex regulates ciliary axonemal microtubule posttranslational modifications and initiation of ciliogenesis.
evidence.snippet: Disruption of the B9-TMEM67 complex reduced posttranslational modifications of axonemal microtubules due to deregulation of tubulin-modifying enzymes within cilia.

evidence.reference_title: A TCTN2 mutation defines a novel Meckel Gruber syndrome locus.

evidence.reference_title: Identification of a novel MKS locus defined by TMEM107 mutation.
evidence.snippet: This study shows that known MKS loci account for the overwhelming majority of MKS cases but additional loci exist including MKS13 caused by TMEM107 mutation.

evidence.reference_title: Missense Variants in the Second Transmembrane Domain of TMEM17 Disrupt Its Stability and Function and Lead to a Wide Phenotypic Spectrum of Ciliopathies.
evidence.snippet: we report two unrelated fetuses with occipital encephalocele, polydactyly, and kidney cysts, in whom exome sequencing identified a founder homozygous missense variant (Arg94Trp) in TMEM17

evidence.reference_title: Missense Variants in the Second Transmembrane Domain of TMEM17 Disrupt Its Stability and Function and Lead to a Wide Phenotypic Spectrum of Ciliopathies.
evidence.snippet: Our study reveals severe functional consequences, including TMEM17 destabilization and mislocalization, anomalies in cilium composition and function, and abrogation of Sonic Hedgehog signaling.

evidence.reference_title: Mutations in TMEM216 perturb ciliogenesis and cause Joubert, Meckel and related syndromes.
evidence.snippet: Mutations in TMEM216 perturb ciliogenesis and cause Joubert, Meckel and related syndromes.

evidence.snippet: Mutations in TMEM231 cause Meckel-Gruber syndrome.

evidence.reference_title: Enhanced diagnostic yield in Meckel-Gruber and Joubert syndrome through exome sequencing supplemented with split-read mapping.
evidence.snippet: These analyses identified a putative intragenic AHI1 deletion that included three exons spanning at least 3.4 kb and an intergenic MPP4 to TMEM237 deletion that included exons spanning at least 21.5 kb.

evidence.reference_title: A mouse model for Meckel syndrome type 3.
evidence.snippet: In humans, the underlying mutated gene, TMEM67, encodes transmembrane protein 67, also called meckelin (OMIM 609884), which is an integral protein of the renal epithelial cell and membrane of the primary cilium.

evidence.reference_title: Meckel syndrome: Clinical and mutation profile in six fetuses.
evidence.snippet: We describe the second family with MKS due to a homozygous variant in B9D2 and fifth family with bi-allelic variant in TXNDC15.

evidence.reference_title: Novel homozygous mutations in TXNDC15 causing Meckel syndrome.
evidence.snippet: We report the case of a homozygous mutation in the TXNDC15 gene, causing MKS14 in the Chinese population.

evidence.reference_title: Biallelic TXNDC15 variants associated with Joubert syndrome-related molar tooth sign and forebrain malformation.
evidence.snippet: Biallelic TXNDC15 variants have been reported in six individuals of Meckel syndrome (MKS) with perinatal lethal phenotypes

evidence.reference_title: CRISPR-Cas9-Generated TXNDC15 c.560delA Homozygous Mouse Model Exhibits Meckel-Gruber Syndrome Phenotype.
evidence.snippet: Homozygous Txndc15mt/mt embryos displayed the complete MKS phenotype-fetal lethality, exencephaly, omphalocele, post-axial polydactyly, and polycystic kidneys-together with markedly reduced TXNDC15 protein in brain, liver, and kidney.
